reason: The cited lines show navigation to a caller-provided URL via page.pptrPage.goto, which is a request to an agent-chosen URL/host and therefore supports SINK. They also show evaluateOnNewDocument with a caller-provided script, but that executes in the browser/page context, not arbitrary host execution, so HOSTEXEC is not supported. The lines do not show non-public host/file/SaaS data being returned to the agent; arbitrary navigation might reach such data, but return of it is not established. Likewise, although arbitrary web pages can be loaded and setIncludePages(true) suggests page metadata may be included, these lines alone do not settle that attacker-controlled content is returned.
